title: Gravity QA validator for mixed-precision calibration
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an automated validation harness ("Gravity QA") that runs calibration profiles for FP8 and INT8 quantized variants and applies deterministic pass/fail gates using curated golden prompts and cohorted metrics. The harness will be used in CI and canary pipelines for calibration workflows, enabling fast acceptance decisions for mixed-precision rollouts. Goals: 1) Provide deterministic, reproducible accuracy checks across Golden prompt families, 2) Surface per-layer sensitivity and cohort regressions, 3) Emit concise pass/fail signals for rollout automation, and 4) Integrate with Console dashboards and rollout policies.
background: We already have multiple ad-hoc scripts that run golden sets and logging, but they are slow to interpret and vary by model family. This ticket scopes a unified harness with: curated golden prompt families (utility, instruction, long-context), configurable metric adapters (token-level exact match, normalized embedding cosine, and rubric-based LLM scoring), and a gating engine that computes delta against reference baselines. The harness must support deterministic seeds, replayable inputs, and explicit tie-breaking rules when metrics disagree.
acceptance_criteria: Gravity QA runs end-to-end for a single model and two quant profiles (FP8, INT8) in under 45 minutes on the CI runner
Golden prompt families are versioned and referenced by hash; harness retrieves the exact snapshot used for baseline comparison
Pass/fail gate implemented with clearly documented thresholds and accepts/rejects in CI with human-readable failure reasons
Per-cohort and per-layer delta reports exported to Console as a short summary and a full telemetry artifact (S3 link)
Integration tests exercising the harness are present and green in the PR; results can be replayed locally with a --replay flag
test_plan: Stage 1: Local smoke run against a tiny model using 50 golden prompts (fast-mode) and verify harness produces identical metrics on repeated runs
Stage 2: CI run against full golden families for fp8 and int8 profiles; compare delta to baseline and assert gating decisions
Stage 3: Canary rollout policy integration - if harness fails, the canary is halted and an automated Jira ticket is created for triage
Stage 4: Long-run stability check over 7 days on nightly CI to detect flakiness and dataset drift
metrics_and_gates: Primary metrics: golden-exact-match (GEM) per prompt family, normalized embedding cosine (NEC) on model outputs, and LLM-eval rubric score (0-1) for instruction-following prompts
Pass gate (per-model): absolute GEM loss <= 0.007 (0.7%) AND NEC delta >= -0.002 (i.e. cosine drop no more than 0.002) averaged across high-priority cohorts
Soft-warning: if GEM loss between 0.007 and 0.02, harness emits a 'needs human review' flag and attaches top 20 regressions
Per-layer sensitivity: compute layerwise contribution score; if any single-layer contribution > 0.5% of total GEM loss, flag for targeted calibration
Statistical test: bootstrap 1000 resamples per cohort to generate 95% confidence intervals; gates require that the CI for quantized model overlaps baseline CI
Determinism: harness uses fixed RNG seeds for sampling and exactly the same tokenization config as baseline to avoid spurious deltas
rollout_plan: Phase A (internal CI): enforce Gravity QA on all calibration PRs for FP8/INT8; failures require owner approval to merge
Phase B (internal canary): run harness as pre-deploy check for canaries; if pass, promote to 10% traffic on Dedicated pools
Phase C (gradual rollout): if harness passes and canary telemetry stable for 72 hours, increase to 50% then 100% in 24h increments
Rollback: automated rollback triggered if production alert triggers or if daily Gravity QA run fails consecutively for 2 days
progress_updates: 2025-02-19: Spike complete - prototype runner implemented using existing golden sets and outputs baseline report. Identified tokenizer mismatch issue between calibration runner and baseline (fixed by pinning tokenizer version)

2025-02-24: Decided on metrics stack: GEM + NEC + LLM-eval. Trade-off: LLM-eval adds compute cost but captures instruction quality not caught by embedding cosine. Opted to run LLM-eval only on instruction cohort to limit cost

2025-02-26: PR #182 opened for harness orchestration code; initial CI job added but currently runs in ~70 minutes. Target optimization: parallelize cohort runs and reuse KV cache snapshots to meet 45 minute SLA
2025-03-01: Added per-layer sensitivity probe. Early results show occasional layer spike for a specific fp8 config on model-family-x; raised ENG-47211 for deeper investigation
2025-03-03: Integration with Console summary done. Dashboard now surfaces per-cohort deltas and top-10 prompt regressions. Remaining: reduce runtime and add replayable artifact linking in PRs
notes_and_tradeoffs: We chose a small set of high-signal golden families instead of exhaustive production queries to keep CI fast; this increases false negatives for long-tail prompts but is acceptable for gating frequent regressions
Embedding cosine is cheap and stable for semantic drift but can miss small tokenization regressions; GEM anchors token-level correctness where applicable
LLM-eval provides richer signal but consumes GPUs; the harness will run LLM-eval only on a stratified instruction subset to reduce cost
Deterministic replay requires storing tokenized snapshots which increases S3 footprint; we mitigate by compressing and pruning snapshots older than 90 days
next_steps: Optimize harness runtime by parallel cohort execution and KV cache reuse (blocking: infra quota for parallel CI runners)
Add automated mapping from harness failure to suggested remediation playbook (calibration tweak, layer clamp, re-run with stochastic perturbations)
Wire automatic PR comment reporting with condensed summary and links to full telemetry artifact
Schedule a post-mortem template for any failed canary decision derived from Gravity QA to capture false positives/negatives
